methodology: All 78 company/category primary-source URLs independently attempted November 1 via web retrieval, supplemented by targeted issuer search and official organizer pages. checked_at is audit finalization, not individual HTTP request time. A verified status means accessible relevant primary-source evidence, not proof of exhaustive dynamically loaded archives. Unavailable, stale-index-only or dynamically empty categories are incomplete; previously verified statuses are not automatically inherited.
